cards.text: This card provides Colorless Energy. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is a Pokémon SP, this card provides every type of Energy buy provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Upper Energy
cards.text: This card provides Colorless Energy. If you have more Prize cards left than your opponent and this card is attached to a Pokémon (excluding Pokémon LV.X), this card provides ColorlessColorless.

cards.name: Alakazam E4 LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Alakazam E4. Alakazam E4 LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Damage Switch
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon SP to another of your Pokémon SP. This power can't be used if Alakazam E4 is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.name: Floatzel GL LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Floatzel GL. Floatzel GL LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Water Rescue
abilities.text: Whenever any of your Water Pokémon (excluding any Floatzel GL) is Knocked Out by damage from your opponent's attack, you may put that Pokémon and all cards that were attached to it from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Energy Cyclone
attacks.text: Choose as many Energy cards from your hand as you like and show them to your opponent. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy cards you chose. Put those Energy cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Flygon LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Flygon. Flygon LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Wind Erosion
abilities.text: As long as Flygon is your Active Pokémon, discard the top card from your opponent's deck between turns.

attacks.name: Extreme Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon LV.X. This attack does 150 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon).

cards.name: Gallade E4 LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Gallade E4. Gallade E4 LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Active Gallade E4, you may put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aimed Cut
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Hippowdon LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Hippowdon. Hippowdon LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Sand Reset
abilities.text: Once during a game on your turn (before your attack), each player shuffles all cards in play (excluding Pokémon and Supporter cards) into their deck. You can't use more than 1 Sand Reset Poké-Power each game.

attacks.name: Double Shoot
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fighting Energy attached to Hippowdon and choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to each of them. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Infernape E4 LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Infernape E4. Infernape E4 LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Intimidating Roar
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Infernape E4 is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Infernape E4.

cards.name: Mismagius GL LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Mismagius GL. Mismagius GL LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Magical Return
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may return a Pokémon Tool or Technical Machine card attached to your Pokémon to your hand. This power can't be used if Mismagius GL is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Darkness Magic
attacks.text: Count the number of cards in your hand. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. You can't put more than 8 damage counters in this way.

cards.name: Snorlax LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Snorlax. Snorlax LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Big Appetite
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Snorlax is your Active Pokémon, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. If you do, Snorlax is now Asleep. This power can't be used if Snorlax is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Exercise
attacks.text: You may discard as many Energy cards as you like from your hand. If you do, remove that many damage counters from Snorlax.

abilities.name: Fan Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. This Pokémon's type is Colorless until the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Spin Storm
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent returns the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to their hand.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Frost Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. This Pokémon's type is Water until the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Crushing Ice
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Colorless Energy in the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost (after applying effects to the Retreat Cost).

abilities.name: Heat Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. This Pokémon's type is Fire until the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Warm Up
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Heat Burn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

abilities.name: Mow Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. This Pokémon's type is Grass until the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Mow Down
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

abilities.name: Wash Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. This Pokémon's type is Water until the end of your turn.

attacks.name: Cleanse Away
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Drain Wash
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

cards.name: Charon's Choice
cards.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, put this card into your hand instead of discarding it. Search your deck for any Rotom and switch it with any Rotom you have in play. Any cards attached to Rotom and damage counters on it are now on the new Pokémon. (Remove all Special Conditions and effects from Rotom.) Put Rotom on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.
